findings.detail: Holdings include the separate PSLF look-through investment schedule even though the parent schedule total at December 31, 2025 is 1,218,474 thousand.

rationale: Class 3 anchor triangulation decides the issue: the filing's own parent investment total is 1,218,474 thousand at table 18 row 26, while the extracted holdings sum is 2,724,607,000. The excess is not supported by the parent anchor and source context shows a separate PSLF investment total of 1,357,342 thousand in table 31 row 2 / table 38 row 3, indicating subsidiary look-through coverage was included against the parent denominator.
